mints.name: StreamingIngestionGap
mints.title: Zypherion's missing streaming ingestion sets off the switch to Meridian, which supersedes the prior Zypherion decision
mints.why: The memo draws an explicit line from a found capability gap (Zypherion lacks streaming ingestion) to the decision to switch to Meridian and to the supersession of the prior decision. No existing stratum groups a decision with the cause it was set off by.
